children.name: Text
children.text:
The step counter double-counts when a patient shuffles. Most false steps in the March recordings come from heel lift under 18 N, which reads as a new strike.

See [[Sensor sampling rates]] for why 100 Hz misses the short lifts, and [[Clinic recording protocol]] for how the sessions were taken.

## Next
- [x] Mark the 41 false steps by hand in session 3
- [ ] Raise the heel strike threshold to 18 N and rerun sessions 1–6
- [ ] Log raw pressure at 200 Hz for one walk
- [ ] Ask the clinic for two shuffling recordings

Shuffling patients matter most: they're who the music orb is for.
